capabilities.title: Company and workspace setup
capabilities.purpose: Set up and discover companies without leaking inaccessible state.
unsupportedBoundaries: MCP does not initialize an arbitrary host path; CLI init is explicitly CLI-only.
Discovery never exposes companies outside the caller's workspace access.

capabilities.title: Company operating knowledge
capabilities.purpose: Retrieve and review source-backed, dated company operating facts.
unsupportedBoundaries: Knowledge never changes ledger, VAT, legal classification or group membership automatically.
Conflicting approved singleton facts remain conflicts; no latest-write selection occurs.

capabilities.title: Document and mail intake
capabilities.purpose: Store source documents and mail attachments for review.
unsupportedBoundaries: Extraction is evidence for review, not approval or automatic posting.
The catalogue contains no mailbox credentials or company routing.

capabilities.title: Workspace document inbox
capabilities.purpose: Route immutable incoming evidence to one authorized legal entity without a workspace ledger.
unsupportedBoundaries: Workspace inbox never posts, calculates VAT or maintains a workspace ledger.
Hidden candidate companies and their metadata are filtered before output, ordering and exception rendering.
A linked or booked document is corrected through its company controls, never silently reassigned.

capabilities.title: Bank reconciliation and bookkeeping batch
capabilities.purpose: Import activity, review one canonical bank work queue and apply a hash-bound batch.
unsupportedBoundaries: reconcile_bank is a report, not an apply operation.
Suggested or human-review items are never auto-approved.
The correction never edits journals, reversals, hashes or legacy reconciliation links.
A current active old journal must be reversed before a correction can be planned.
The workbench never creates a reconciliation, task database or posting.
A row is not dismissible: only canonical reconciliation, correction or reviewed batch effects change completion.

capabilities.title: Supplier expenses and payables
capabilities.purpose: Book supplier invoices directly or through payable handling.
unsupportedBoundaries: The workflow never changes a document hash or metadata.
Journal history is reversed and appended, never rewritten.

capabilities.title: Supplier commitments and 13-week liquidity
capabilities.purpose: Review recurring supplier commitments and inspect a source-linked cash forecast without generating payments.
unsupportedBoundaries: A recurring bank pattern is only a proposal, never a contract.
This workflow never creates invoices, payables, journals, payments, cancellations or supplier messages.
Foreign currency is excluded unless an explicit dated FX source exists.

capabilities.title: Customer invoice lifecycle
capabilities.purpose: Create customers and handle issue, delivery, payment, reminder and correction.
unsupportedBoundaries: Issue does not imply delivery or payment.
No external send is retried blindly after uncertainty.

capabilities.title: VAT preparation
capabilities.purpose: Validate and post supported VAT treatments and prepare evidence.
unsupportedBoundaries: This workflow does not file with an authority.
Only documented taxable lines create input VAT.

capabilities.title: Exceptions and corrections
capabilities.purpose: Resolve blockers and correct through append-only reversals.
unsupportedBoundaries: Posted entries and original documents are never overwritten or deleted.

capabilities.title: Period management
capabilities.purpose: Inspect, close and explicitly reopen periods.
unsupportedBoundaries: Period reopen is CLI-only; no MCP parity is claimed.

capabilities.title: Backup, health and audit
capabilities.purpose: Verify integrity and create, place, verify or restore backups.
unsupportedBoundaries: Rentemester does not choose provider retention policy.
Restore never targets an implicit path.

capabilities.title: Portfolio, group and intercompany
capabilities.purpose: Inspect group state, reconcile mappings and document two-sided dispositions without cross-ledger posting.
unsupportedBoundaries: Each legal entity keeps its own ledger.
Group operations remain CLI/HTTP-only where no MCP operation is listed.
This flow never posts, reverses or eliminates either legal ledger.
Group eliminations remain a separate read-only/reporting concern.

capabilities.title: CFO analytics
capabilities.purpose: Query source-linked current and archived history across an authorised company, portfolio or approved group report.
unsupportedBoundaries: Portfolio output is not legal consolidation and never applies eliminations or inferred FX conversion.
Group output fails closed unless an approved existing consolidation profile supports the requested scope.
No AI classification is added to accounting facts.

capabilities.title: DigiSense and NemHandel
capabilities.purpose: Onboard, send once, read status and receive electronic invoices.
unsupportedBoundaries: Test and production are explicit.
Discovery exposes no credentials or participant identities.

capabilities.title: Imports including Dinero

unsupportedBoundaries: No company-specific mapping is inferred.

capabilities.title: Mileage
